fields.statement: At 4c9e4641 ran go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/bugfix-workflow-autonomous$' -count=1: ok. Read the script and diff: fake rex, claude and gh (gh answers pr view from a bare origin); repo .rhiza/workflows/bugfix.toml and bugfix-ship.toml declare autonomous = true and dispatch.toml maps request/ready kind bug to them; git config rhiza.autonomy.plan owner and rhiza.autonomy.signoff owner. The daemon starts the bug request's plan run with --autonomous, the run succeeds with Autonomous: yes and its gate journals one accepted entry (rule autonomous); the daemon then starts the bugfix-ship run --autonomous, which signs off by rule autonomous (no actor), pushes, passes rhiza ship check through the fake gh, and runs rhiza ship land: the change set reads landed and the run branch head equals origin's cs/fix-crash. rhiza inbox --json holds no item after the daemon start, after the plan run, and after the ship run. This fixes the earlier finding that landing was never exercised.
